name: Legacy seam extraction

problemSignals.description: A legacy responsibility depends on callers, globals, or effects that are not explicit at its boundary.
Shared mutable state makes behavior difficult to isolate and reason about.
One path combines responsibilities with side effects that prevent focused testing or change.
External effects are embedded in logic without a controllable boundary.

requiredEvidence.description: Observed callers, dependencies, state reads and writes, and control-flow relation for the target responsibility.
Inventory of external effects, ordering constraints, failure behavior, and ownership.
Characterization evidence for the old path that must remain valid through extraction.

assumptions: The target responsibility has a boundary that can be named and observed
The old path can remain available while the extracted seam is verified
Dependencies and side effects can be represented by explicit ports

deterministicSteps.action: Trace the target responsibility through callers and dependencies, then map its state and side-effect relations.
Choose the smallest boundary that isolates the responsibility while preserving dependency ordering and the old-path contract.
Replay the old-path observations and verify equivalent behavior, side effects, and rollback route after the seam change.

outputs.description: Call, dependency, state, and side-effect relation around the target responsibility.
Smallest explicit boundary and preserved contract for the extracted seam.
Verified route back to the old path if the seam change cannot preserve behavior.

whenAll: All relevant callers and side effects are mapped
The boundary preserves ordering and the old-path contract
Old-path replay and rollback are verified
The seam and primary dependencies are explicit
Long-tail callers or effects remain partially observed
Dependencies or side effects cannot be isolated
The old path has no reproducible contract or rollback route

contraindications: No stable responsibility boundary can be identified
Extraction would require changing an unobserved contract
Side effects cannot be isolated or safely replayed

contract: Trace declared callers, dependencies, and effects
Emit a bounded seam map without selecting or executing a migration

inScope: Extracting testable responsibilities from legacy paths
Making global state and effects explicit
